profile_text.body:
DreamBox by Discovery Education describes itself as offering online math and reading programs for students, built around personalized, adaptive instruction. The site says DreamBox Math and Reading are designed so educators can scale differentiation, and that the programs meet every student where they are and keep them growing. DreamBox Math is described as a K-8 adaptive math program that integrates curriculum and continuous formative assessment, while DreamBox Reading is described as a K-5 data-driven program for schools that the company says is proven to improve silent reading fluency, comprehension and vocabulary. The site also says DreamBox Learning's solutions are now part of Discovery Education's family of products.

The company's tracked product is DreamBox Math, listed under Education and Research AI with adaptive lessons for K-8 math, used by students and teachers on school accounts. Pricing is quote-based through Discovery Education, though third parties list $20 per student per year or $7,000 per school. The product note records that DreamBox has been owned by Discovery Education since 2023, and that the entry was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. Privacy terms are not verified.
